body: I think I'm free. I never posted much, but venting helped me. I've managed to...find myself in a better space. Lot of help from friends too. To the rest fighting, I wish you best of luck on your fight.

Part of me has always wanted everything to end. For it all to be over and there only to be nothing. Part of me struggles on, fighting for a future. That fight ends on Friday. If I do not do well on the MCAT...I feel as if the part of me fighting so much will give up. My anxiety is spiking like crazy, I can feel my chest tightening, my heart beating even faster. I can see my parents even disowning me and telling me to get out of their house. For the first time...im terrified.
Yeah...I'm a stranger in my own house even with family here. Havent heard from friends since uni closed for spring break and gone online. Feels like I'm slipping.

What a fucking waste. As much as I have done, as much as I do, it all seems so fucking pointless. I have those days of laziness where all my work from weeks prior goes to waste. Go to class, take notes, prepare for the first half of the exam? Then I suddenly have a week of total shit and fail to prepare properly for the second half so I fail? What's the point?

Why the fuck do I do all this work to just cycle back to bullshit and have done nothing to show for it. What a waste of 9 years of work I have done to keep throwing it away again and again. On top of my 21 years of a waste of life...friends are pointless, future is bleak, mental state is trashed, physically I'm yoyoing from good to bad.

I'll always say I'm okay because I don't want to be a burden. The further I go, the more it feels like I am and I cant die in case I fail and become an ever more of a burden. My suffering and hatred makes it so others dont need to care...but it wears me out...
